spec.expr: max(sum by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_request_desired_bytes{host_name="$cluster"}) * on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) group_left (k8s_node_name) group by (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_node_name) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node", k8s_node_name!="", state!~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))) / on (host_name, k8s_node_name) max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_memory_allocatable_bytes{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", "")))

spec.title: Fullest node pod slots
spec.description: Highest share of a node's pod capacity (maxPods, 250 by default on OpenShift) in use.

spec.expr: max(count by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node", k8s_node_name!="", state!~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) / on (host_name, k8s_node_name) max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_pod_allocatable{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", "")))

spec.title: Survives a node loss?
spec.description: Requests of all active pods divided by the allocatable capacity minus the largest node. At 100% or more, the pods of a failed or drained node (upgrade, MachineConfig reboot) cannot all be rescheduled. Ignores the node filter.

spec.expr: max(sum by (host_name) (sum by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_request_desired{host_name="$cluster"}) * on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) group_left (k8s_node_name) group by (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_node_name) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name!="", state!~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)))) / (sum by (host_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_cpu_allocatable{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", ""))) - max by (host_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_cpu_allocatable{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", "")))))

max(sum by (host_name) (sum by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_request_desired_bytes{host_name="$cluster"}) * on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) group_left (k8s_node_name) group by (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_node_name) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name!="", state!~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)))) / (sum by (host_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_memory_allocatable_bytes{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", ""))) - max by (host_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_memory_allocatable_bytes{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", "")))))

spec.description: Sum of the memory limits of active pods versus allocatable memory. Above 100%, pods cannot all reach their limits at once: under load this ends in OOM kills or evictions. Containers without a limit are not counted.

spec.expr: max(sum by (host_name) (sum by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_limit_desired_bytes{host_name="$cluster"}) * on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) group_left (k8s_node_name) group by (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_node_name) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node", k8s_node_name!="", state!~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)))) / sum by (host_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_memory_allocatable_bytes{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", ""))))

spec.title: CPU limits overcommit

spec.title: Node readiness and pressure

spec.title: Anomalies over time
spec.description:
Anomaly counters over the time range, one row per check, one cell per time step: green when none, red with the count otherwise (dark red from 5). The last column is now. An empty (grey) cell means no data: the collection stopped. Click a cell to open the table that lists what the check counts.

- **Nodes not ready**: Nodes whose Ready condition is not True (False, Unknown or missing): kubelet stopped, node unreachable or network lost.
- **Nodes under pressure**: Nodes reporting MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure or NetworkUnavailable (or one of them Unknown).
- **Cluster operators not OK**: Platform components (etcd, kube-apiserver, ingress, network, ...) that are not Available or are Degraded.
- **Installed operators not OK**: OperatorHub (OLM) operators whose ClusterServiceVersion failed, or that are stuck installing or updating, in the whole cluster (the namespace filter does not apply).
- **Machine config pools not OK**: MachineConfigPools that are degraded, or that contain degraded machines: a node failed to apply its MachineConfig (OS or configuration update).
- **Pods stuck Pending**: Pods Pending for 5 minutes or more: no node fits (CPU, memory, pod slots, taints, affinity), a PersistentVolumeClaim is not bound, or the image is still pulling.
- **Pods failed (1h) / Unknown**: Pods that turned Failed during the last hour (evicted, rejected, all containers ended in error), or Unknown (node unreachable).
- **Containers failing to run**: Containers of live pods seen in CrashLoopBackOff, ErrImagePull, ImagePullBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError or ContainerCannotRun during the last 10 minutes, or waiting for 5 minutes without an exported reason (failing init containers, CreateContainerError, InvalidImageName).
- **OOM kills (24h)**: Containers OOM killed during the last 24 hours (memory limit reached, or node out of memory): their restart count grew and their last termination is OOMKilled, or they are terminated by an OOM kill right now.
- **Deployments not available**: Deployments with fewer available pods than desired: rollout in progress, pods crashing or not ready, or no room to schedule them.
- **StatefulSets not ready**: StatefulSets with fewer ready pods than desired.
- **DaemonSets not ready**: DaemonSets whose pod is missing or not ready on some nodes (CNI, DNS, CSI, monitoring agents).
- **Jobs failed or stuck**: CronJobs (or standalone Jobs) whose latest known outcome is a failure (failed Job, no newer run seen since), with a Job that has had no pod for 15 minutes, or blocked with an active Job that runs no pod.
- **PVCs not bound**: PersistentVolumeClaims Pending for 15 minutes or more (no volume provisioned or matched; with WaitForFirstConsumer classes, also a claim whose pod is not scheduled) or Lost (the volume is gone).
- **Services that lost their endpoints**: Services whose ready endpoints dropped to 0 although they had some during the last 24 hours, and not explained by a workload scaled to 0: traffic goes nowhere (503 or connection refused).
- **Quotas >= 90%**: ResourceQuota or ClusterResourceQuota entries used at 90% or more of their hard limit: new pods, PVCs or objects of the project will be refused (exceeded quota).

spec.expr: (count(k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)
(count(k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)
(count(k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)
(count(k8s_hpa_pod_max{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)
(count(k8s_cronjob_job_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)
(count(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Replica availability
spec.description: Share of the pods wanted by Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets that are available or ready.

spec.expr: (((sum(k8s_deployment_pod_available{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(k8s_statefulset_pod_ready{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(k8s_daemonset_node_ready{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0))) / ((sum(k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)))) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Missing replicas
spec.description: Pods missing across Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets (a rolling-update surge does not hide pods missing elsewhere).

spec.expr: ((sum(clamp_min((k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_deployment_pod_available), 0)) or vector(0)) + (sum(clamp_min((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready), 0)) or vector(0)) + (sum(clamp_min((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_daemonset_node_ready), 0)) or vector(0))) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Deployments down
spec.description: Deployments that want pods but have none available: an outage.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_deployment_pod_available{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0 and k8s_deployment_pod_desired > 0) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: HPAs saturated
spec.description: Autoscalers at their maximum replicas (pinned HPAs with min = max excluded): the next load peak will not get more pods. Raise maxReplicas or the cluster capacity.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_hpa_pod_current{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} >= k8s_hpa_pod_max and k8s_hpa_pod_max > k8s_hpa_pod_min) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: HPAs pinned
spec.description: Autoscalers with minReplicas = maxReplicas: they can never scale. A configuration smell, not an outage.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_hpa_pod_max{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == k8s_hpa_pod_min) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Stuck jobs
spec.description: Jobs with no pod at all for 15 minutes (quota, admission or SCC denial, or suspended). With concurrencyPolicy Forbid they block their CronJob.

spec.expr: (count((max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[15m]) + max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[15m]) + max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_successful{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[15m])) == 0 and (k8s_job_pod_active offset 15m) and k8s_job_pod_active) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Failed jobs, no newer run
spec.description: Failed Jobs whose CronJob was not seen running again after the failure during the last 24 hours: the latest known outcome is a failure.

spec.expr: (count(label_replace((k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0 and max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[10m]) == 0) unless k8s_job_pod_successful >= k8s_job_pod_desired_successful, "k8s_cronjob_name", "$1", "k8s_job_name", "(.+)-[0-9]{8,}") unless on (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_job_name) (label_replace(min_over_time(timestamp(k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0)[24h:2m]), "k8s_cronjob_name", "$1", "k8s_job_name", "(.+)-[0-9]{8,}") < on (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_cronjob_name) group_left () max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_cronjob_name) (label_replace(max_over_time(timestamp(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_job_name=~".+-[0-9]{8,}"} > 0)[24h:2m]) unless on (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_job_name) (k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0), "k8s_cronjob_name", "$1", "k8s_job_name", "(.+)-[0-9]{8,}")))) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Scaled to zero
spec.description: Deployments and StatefulSets with 0 desired replicas, and DaemonSets whose node selector matches no node. Usually intentional.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0 or k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0 or k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_namespace_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Node CPU usage
spec.description: CPU used on each node (kubelet summary) relative to its allocatable CPU, over the time range: darker green as the load grows, yellow from 70%, orange from 80%, red from 90%. A node that stays red runs out of CPU: its pods are throttled. Click a cell to filter the dashboard on the node.

spec.expr: max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_cpu_usage{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", "")) / on (host_name, k8s_node_name) max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_cpu_allocatable{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", ""))

links.title: Filter the dashboard on this node

spec.title: StatefulSets not ready or rolling out
spec.description: StatefulSets with pods not ready, or whose updated replicas differ from desired (rollout in progress, stuck on an ordinal, or by design with OnDelete or a partition).

spec.expr: k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready) > 0 or k8s_statefulset_pod_updated != k8s_statefulset_pod_desired)

k8s_statefulset_pod_ready{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready) > 0 or k8s_statefulset_pod_updated != k8s_statefulset_pod_desired)

k8s_statefulset_pod_current{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready) > 0 or k8s_statefulset_pod_updated != k8s_statefulset_pod_desired)

k8s_statefulset_pod_updated{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready) > 0 or k8s_statefulset_pod_updated != k8s_statefulset_pod_desired)

defaults.noValue: All StatefulSets ready and up to date

value.title: Open the StatefulSet in the OpenShift console

spec.title: DaemonSets not fully scheduled or ready
spec.description: DaemonSets missing on some nodes, not ready, or running on nodes that should not run them.

spec.expr: k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_ready) > 0 or (k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_current_scheduled) > 0 or k8s_daemonset_node_misscheduled > 0)

k8s_daemonset_node_current_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_ready) > 0 or (k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_current_scheduled) > 0 or k8s_daemonset_node_misscheduled > 0)

k8s_daemonset_node_ready{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_ready) > 0 or (k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_current_scheduled) > 0 or k8s_daemonset_node_misscheduled > 0)

k8s_daemonset_node_misscheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and ((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_ready) > 0 or (k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled - k8s_daemonset_node_current_scheduled) > 0 or k8s_daemonset_node_misscheduled > 0)

defaults.noValue: All DaemonSets fully scheduled and ready

value.title: Open the DaemonSet in the OpenShift console

spec.title: Workloads degraded during the time range
spec.description: Workloads that missed pods at some point of the time range, even if they recovered (flapping, slow rollouts, restarts). Value: the most pods missing at once.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time((k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_deployment_pod_available)[$__range:1m]) > 0, "kind", "Deployment", "", ""), "resource", "deployments", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_deployment_name", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready)[$__range:1m]) > 0, "kind", "StatefulSet", "", ""), "resource", "statefulsets", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_statefulset_name", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_daemonset_node_ready)[$__range:1m]) > 0, "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""), "resource", "daemonsets", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_daemonset_name", "(.*)")

defaults.noValue: No workload degraded in the time range

value.title: Open the workload in the OpenShift console

spec.title: Scaled to zero
spec.description: Workloads with 0 desired replicas (or DaemonSets matching no node). Check that it is intentional.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0, "kind", "Deployment", "", ""), "resource", "deployments", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_deployment_name", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0, "kind", "StatefulSet", "", ""), "resource", "statefulsets", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_statefulset_name", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 0, "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""), "resource", "daemonsets", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_daemonset_name", "(.*)")

value.title: Open the workload in the OpenShift console

spec.title: Stuck Jobs and blocked CronJobs
spec.description: Jobs without any pod for 15 minutes, and CronJobs that report an active Job while none of their Jobs runs a pod (they may be blocked by concurrencyPolicy Forbid). A suspended Job looks the same.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[15m]) + max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[15m]) + max_over_time(k8s_job_pod_successful{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[15m])) == 0 and (k8s_job_pod_active offset 15m) and k8s_job_pod_active, "kind", "Job", "", ""), "resource", "jobs", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_job_name", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(k8s_cronjob_job_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0 unless on (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_cronjob_name) label_replace(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0, "k8s_cronjob_name", "$1", "k8s_job_name", "(.+)-[0-9]{8,}"), "kind", "CronJob", "", ""), "resource", "cronjobs", "", ""), "object", "$1", "k8s_cronjob_name", "(.*)")

value.title: Open the workload in the OpenShift console

spec.title: Jobs retrying
spec.description: Jobs with failed pods that are still running: crash looping through their backoffLimit.

spec.expr: k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0 and k8s_job_pod_active > 0

value.title: Open the Job in the OpenShift console

spec.title: HPA issues
spec.description: Autoscalers at max (scalable ones only), with desired different from current for more than 10 minutes (scaling blocked), or below their minimum.

spec.expr: label_replace(k8s_hpa_pod_current{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} >= k8s_hpa_pod_max and k8s_hpa_pod_max > k8s_hpa_pod_min, "issue", "At max", "", "") or label_replace((k8s_hpa_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} != k8s_hpa_pod_current) and (k8s_hpa_pod_desired offset 10m != k8s_hpa_pod_current offset 10m), "issue", "Scaling blocked > 10m", "", "") or label_replace(k8s_hpa_pod_current{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} < k8s_hpa_pod_min, "issue", "Below min", "", "")

spec.title: HPA headroom
spec.description: Current replicas relative to maxReplicas for the autoscalers that can scale (min < max). At 100% the HPA cannot add pods.

spec.expr: k8s_hpa_pod_current{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} / k8s_hpa_pod_max and k8s_hpa_pod_max > k8s_hpa_pod_min

spec.title: Jobs over time
spec.description: Running Jobs, failed Jobs and Jobs that CronJobs consider active. Short Jobs (under one collect cycle) are not seen.

spec.expr: count(k8s_job_pod_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0) or vector(0)
count(k8s_job_pod_failed{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0 and k8s_job_pod_active == 0 unless k8s_job_pod_successful >= k8s_job_pod_desired_successful) or vector(0)
sum(k8s_cronjob_job_active{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"})

spec.title: Missing replicas by kind
spec.description: When capacity dropped, and whether Deployments, StatefulSets or DaemonSets were affected.

spec.expr: sum(clamp_min((k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_deployment_pod_available), 0))
sum(clamp_min((k8s_statefulset_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_statefulset_pod_ready), 0))
sum(clamp_min((k8s_daemonset_node_desired_scheduled{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} - k8s_daemonset_node_ready), 0))

spec.title: Node memory usage
spec.description: Memory working set of each node relative to its allocatable memory, over the time range: darker green as the load grows, yellow from 70%, orange from 80%, red from 90%. Close to 100%, the kubelet evicts pods (MemoryPressure) and the kernel OOM kills containers. Click a cell to filter the dashboard on the node.

spec.expr: max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", "")) / on (host_name, k8s_node_name) max by (host_name, k8s_node_name) (label_replace(k8s_node_memory_allocatable_bytes{k8s_cluster_name="$cluster_name", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}, "host_name", "$cluster", "", ""))

links.title: Filter the dashboard on this node

spec.title: HPA replicas vs limits
spec.description: Sum of current replicas of the autoscalers that can scale (min < max) versus their min and max. Current close to max means little autoscaling headroom.

spec.expr: sum(k8s_hpa_pod_current{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and on (host_name, id) (k8s_hpa_pod_max > k8s_hpa_pod_min))
sum(k8s_hpa_pod_max{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and on (host_name, id) (k8s_hpa_pod_max > k8s_hpa_pod_min))
sum(k8s_hpa_pod_min{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and on (host_name, id) (k8s_hpa_pod_max > k8s_hpa_pod_min))

spec.title: Desired Deployment replicas by namespace
spec.description: Who scaled what, and when (scale events, accidental scale-downs, HPA activity). The 10 namespaces with the most desired replicas over the time range.

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) and on (k8s_namespace_name) topk(10, sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (avg_over_time(k8s_deployment_pod_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end())))

spec.title: Running pods
spec.description: Pods in the Running phase.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", state="Running"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Pending pods
spec.description: Pods waiting to be scheduled or to start. CronJob pods pass through Pending briefly; see Pods stuck Pending in the banner.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", state="Pending"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Unscheduled pods
spec.description: Pending pods without a node: no node fits their requests, taints, affinity or volume constraints. The direct symptom of capacity exhaustion.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name="", state="Pending"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Evicted / rejected pods
spec.description: Pods evicted for node pressure or rejected by their node (Evicted, NodeAffinity, NodeLost, Shutdown, UnexpectedAdmissionError).

spec.expr: (count(k8s_pod_status_reason{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Unknown pods
spec.description: Pods whose state cannot be read, usually because their node is unreachable.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", state="Unknown"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: CrashLoopBackOff
spec.description: Containers seen in CrashLoopBackOff during the last 10 minutes. Check the logs of the previous instance: 'oc logs -p'.

spec.expr: (count(max_over_time(k8s_container_status_reason{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", state="CrashLoopBackOff"}[10m]) == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Image pull errors
spec.description: Containers that cannot pull their image: wrong tag, registry down, missing pull secret.

spec.expr: (count(k8s_container_status_reason{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", state=~"ErrImagePull|ImagePullBackOff"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) or vector(0)) and on () (count(k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0) and on () (count(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"}) > 0)

spec.title: Namespaces with anomalies
spec.description: Namespaces (projects) that had at least one anomaly during the time range, with the number of anomalies of each time step: pods stuck Pending, failed or Unknown, containers failing to run or OOM killed, workloads not fully ready, failed or stuck Jobs, PVCs not bound, Services that lost their endpoints and quotas at 90%. A namespace without anomaly is not listed. Click a cell to filter the dashboard on the namespace.

spec.expr: label_replace(topk(20, max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name, k8s_container_status_last_terminated_reason) (k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) > 0 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)), "k8s_container_status_last_terminated_reason", "-", "k8s_container_status_last_terminated_reason", "")

spec.title: Containers last OOMKilled
spec.description: Containers whose previous termination was an OOM kill, with their restart count: raise the memory limit or fix the leak.

spec.title: Containers without requests
spec.description: Containers with neither a CPU nor a memory request (BestEffort risk). Set requests so the scheduler accounts for them.

spec.expr: k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} unless on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) k8s_container_cpu_request_desired unless on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) k8s_container_memory_request_desired_bytes and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", state=~"Running|Pending"} == 1) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)

spec.title: Pods closest to their memory limit
spec.description: Working set relative to the sum of the container memory limits (pods where every container has a limit). Above 90%, the pod is at risk of an OOM kill; the working set includes active page cache that the kernel reclaims first (databases and search engines run high).

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid) (k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) / sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_limit_desired_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"})) unless on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} unless on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) k8s_container_memory_limit_desired_bytes) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))

defaults.noValue: No pod with a memory limit on every container

spec.title: Containers closest to their CPU limit
spec.description: CPU usage relative to the CPU limit. Near 100% the container is throttled. CronJob pods (batch) are left out.

spec.expr: topk(15, max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_limit_utilization_ratio{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_pod_name!~".+-[0-9]{8,}-[a-z0-9]{5}"}) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))

defaults.noValue: No container with a CPU limit

spec.title: Containers bursting above their CPU request
spec.description: Cores used above the CPU request: CPU the scheduler did not reserve (noisy neighbours, first throttled under contention). Raise the request.

spec.expr: sort_desc(max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_request_utilization_ratio{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) * max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_request_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) - max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_request_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) > 0.1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))

defaults.noValue: No container bursting above its request

spec.title: Idle CPU requests by namespace
spec.description: Cores reserved by requests but not used: capacity blocked for nothing. Lower the requests of these namespaces.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_request_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", state=~"Running|Pending"} == 1) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) - sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name) (k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)))

spec.title: CPU used / requested by namespace
spec.description: The 15 lowest ratios among namespaces requesting more than 0.1 core: reserved CPU that is never used. Above 100%, the namespace relies on CPU the scheduler did not reserve.

spec.expr: sort(bottomk(15, sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name) (k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) / (sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_request_desired{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", state=~"Running|Pending"} == 1) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) > 0.1)))

spec.title: Memory used / requested by namespace
spec.description: The 15 highest ratios. Above 100%, pods rely on memory the scheduler did not reserve and are first in line for eviction. Raise the memory requests. Bars stop at 200%.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(15, sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name) (k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) / sum by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_request_desired_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", state=~"Running|Pending"} == 1) and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))))

spec.title: Top 10 pods by CPU
spec.description: Pods using the most CPU right now (cores).

spec.expr: topk(10, k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))

spec.title: Platform objects not OK
spec.description: Cluster version, cluster operators, installed operators, machine config pools and namespaces stuck terminating that are not healthy, worst first. The reason is not exported to Prometheus: use 'oc describe' or the MetricsHub Web UI.

spec.expr: 2 * max by (host_name, kind, name, state) (label_replace({__name__=~"openshift_(clusterversion|clusteroperator|operator|machineconfigpool)_status|k8s_namespace_phase", host_name="$cluster", state="failed"} == 1, "kind", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)")) or max by (host_name, kind, name, state) (label_replace({__name__=~"openshift_(clusterversion|clusteroperator|operator|machineconfigpool)_status|k8s_namespace_phase", host_name="$cluster", state=~"degraded|terminating"} == 1, "kind", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)"))

spec.title: Top 10 pods by memory
spec.description: Pods with the largest memory working set right now (the value used for evictions and OOM).

spec.expr: topk(10, k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))

spec.title: Pods by phase
spec.description: Did pods start failing or pile up in Pending, and when? Running is on the right axis so that the small counts stay readable.

spec.expr: count by (state) (k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} == 1 and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30))

spec.title: Container restarts by namespace
spec.description: Restarts per interval and namespace.

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) - max by (host_name, k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_restart_count{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} offset $__interval)) > 0

defaults.noValue: No restart in the time range

spec.title: CPU usage by namespace
spec.description: CPU used by the 10 namespaces using the most CPU on average over the time range (stacked cores).

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) and on (k8s_namespace_name) topk(10, sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (avg_over_time(k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())))

spec.title: Memory working set by namespace
spec.description: Memory used by the 10 namespaces using the most memory on average over the time range (stacked). A steady climb is a leak.

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) >= on (host_name) group_left max by (host_name) (timestamp(k8s_pod_status_phase{host_name="$cluster"})) - 30)) and on (k8s_namespace_name) topk(10, sum by (k8s_namespace_name) (avg_over_time(k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())))

spec.title: Top 10 pods by CPU over the range
spec.description: CPU history of the 10 pods with the highest average over the time range.

spec.expr: k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) topk(10, avg_over_time(k8s_pod_cpu_usage{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end()))

spec.title: Top 10 pods by memory over the range
spec.description: Memory history of the 10 pods with the highest peak over the time range (leak detection).

spec.expr: k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} and on (host_name, k8s_pod_uid) topk(10, max_over_time(k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{host_name="$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end()))
